title: Decision log
notes: The archive-not-delete discipline mirrors Scout's own entry lifecycle. Distinct from the changelog step: the changelog records what changed; the decision log records why choices were made.
instruction: Maintain DECISIONS.md as an append-only log of meaningful project decisions. One entry per decision, newest last: a short numbered title (D-001, D-002, …), the date, a status (proposed → accepted), and the reasoning in a few sentences. An overturned decision is never deleted — it stays in the log marked superseded by its successor. Record each decision at the moment it is made, while the reasoning is fresh; create the file on the first decision if it does not exist yet.
